provenance.recovered_from: mlsys2025style/text/eval_rebuild.tex (last modified 2026-10-10), tables and LaTeX source comments
provenance.original_status: LOST: the branch was never pushed and the trn2 host expired; raw JSON receipts, driver scripts and figure renderers are gone
provenance.caveat: Values are transcribed from the paper text, not from receipts. Precision is whatever the paper printed. Fields marked derived were computed during recovery from other printed values.
provenance.platform: 1x AWS trn2.3xlarge, 1 Trainium2 chip, 96 GiB HBM, 124 GB host memory, LNC=2 (4 logical NeuronCores)

protocol.default_config: BF16 denoiser, TP=4, step caching off
protocol.repeats: images: median of 5 after 1 warm-up; video: median of 3
protocol.cooldown_reason: device slows up to 25-30% under back-to-back load, recovers after 90 s idle
protocol.quality_prompts: 16 per modality; images 8 DrawBench + 8 PartiPrompts; video 16 VBench; none used for calibration
protocol.quality_metrics: PSNR (dB, 8-bit), SSIM, LPIPS vs caching-off output of same model/prompt/seed; frame-averaged for video
protocol.caching_common: 5 initial and 5 final full steps in every mode; online-delta alpha=0.6; calibrated adaptive threshold set to cadence-2 skip budget

E2_attribution.description: Cumulative warm request latency (s), starting from standalone PyTorch/XLA. Rows 1-2 shard the checkpoint at load time. Caching = fixed cadence 2.

caching_signal_boundary.description: Calibrated adaptive probe cost per scheduler step and fit R^2 over 8 recording prompts.
caching_signal_boundary.sources: ms/step = (adaptive loop - off loop x executed/total) / steps; fit_r2 from p8-*-calib-*; Wan and LTX-2 calibration pairs recorded with host computation of the block-0 signal

E5a_startup.description: Startup of one resident model at TP=4 until server ready. recompiles = programs rebuilt switching caching off -> calibrated adaptive.
E5a_startup.sources: srv-*-first (compile policy AUTO, empty caches); srv-*-restart-{cold,warm} (NEVER policy, incl. one smoke request); e5a-recompile-*-20261008T0657
E5a_startup.notes: video serving exposes no step-caching policy; off->off recompiles 0; changing adaptive target 1.667x->1.3x recompiles 0

E5a_recovery.known_gap: a worker that dies before reporting ready is not detected; startup waits the full 900 s timeout

E5b_open_loop_load.description: difflet serve over HTTP, open-loop Poisson; TP4 vs two TP2 servers (least-in-flight routing). Same arrivals for both. 20 requests per level. rho = realized arrival rate x isolated TP4 latency (14.2 s). SLO = 30 s.
E5b_open_loop_load.source: e5b-flux-{tp4,dp2tp2}-20261009T0526 (drivers/e5b_load.py over benchmark.serve_bench.run_poisson); nominal rho 0.5/0.8/0.95, arrival seeds 42/43/44; realized windows 365/286/241 s vs expected 568/355/299 s
